reviews.comment: Dr. Dietrich is a wonderful and sweet lady but a very tough professor. Taking extremely good notes was crucial for the exams since you needed to know everything word for word to do well. The exams were a few multiple choice and 5 essay questions, she is picky about what she expects and will knock off points for not mentioning EVERYTHING.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Take this course with someone else. She provides very unclear instructions and grades very harshly. When you email for help, she can be very rude and still not provide an answer to your question. I had never met a professor that wants her students to fail until I took her course.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took Professor Dietrich Summer 1 and she was literally the best professor I ever had. There were 6 papers due and we had lectures every single day that lasted the entire hour and 1/2 but she made them so interesting with her stories and tidbits intertwined. She really cares about her students and is so sweet! I will miss her and her class!
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I took Prof Dietrich for Summer 1 and it wasn't bad. Definitely one of the more difficult classes I've taken, but she wasn't awful. She was an interesting woman and had stories to tell throughout her lectures. Class was composed of 6 assignments. She gave us readings, but definitely lecture heavy. Make sure to participate as that is important.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I completely respect Dr. Dietrich as a professor. She answered my emails very quickly. Throughout the class, you have 3 tests and 1 paper. The paper needs to be 15 pages over something you're passionate about. The tests are a little tricky. ATTEND CLASS that way you can thoroughly complete the study guide. Have the readings handy.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Dietrich was the worst professor. She gives 3 exams with little to no instruction. Her lectures are extremely boring. She doesn't respond to emails. One guy even had to petition to Q-drop because she was that bad. If you care about your grades at all DO NOT TAKE HER!
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I have never met a professor at a&m that wants their students to fail until Dr. Dietrich. She gives no instructions on anything and then fails you even though you answered everything in her extremely unclear instructions. If you email her she will be rude and not even read your email so don't bother. Take this course with someone else.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Her test instructions lead to confusion and therefore poor performance. Instead of having a clear essay question this professor would rather have you assume what she wants and grade you accordingly. There is zero respect from her, zero explanation for grades, and zero reason to take this class.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Not a good professor. Her lectures are so disorganized and she only reads from the slides and talks too fast. Didn't learn a single thing. Says "um" about 15 times in one sentence and very hard to follow. She's not a fair grader by any means. Would not recommend this class to literally anyone.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is by far one of the worst classes I have ever taken at A&M. If you get the chance to take this class with someone else, definitely take that option. I've never had a worse grading professor in my life. Her tests are 2-3 questions and doesn't even ask the questions with all the parts she's looking for, therefore you fail. TERRIBLE prof, sorry.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: If I could give her a 0 I would. She is the WORST professor I have ever taken at A&M. I don't know how she has good reviews. I AM WARNING YOU DO NOT TAKE HER!!! Literally take anyone else... you can thank me later.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She cares so much about her students and is very passionate abut the material. She posts readings online for the tests but most of the info comes from lecture. She posts review sheets which covers almost everything on the tests. Tests are a little challenging but not too bad plus she gives extra credit. 3 tests and 1 paper.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Dietrich is very knowledgable on the subject and makes the lectures interactive and interesting. This class only had 3 exams & a 15 page term paper, so I wouldn't take this class unless you're especially interested in the topics. Exams are from lecture and readings posted to ecampus and aren't too difficult. Paper wasn't graded harshly.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dietrich is a pro at her subject. She is so knowledgeable and given that this is a 400 level course she expects a lot. Her exams are very extensive and she has many writing assignments that make you apply social theory to your life. She is accessible and will explain things to you if you ask. Her exams are hard but if you study you will do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is a great professor. I also had her for 230 (took 3 times before & wasn't getting it) & she's very clear about what she's looking for & gives reviews for every test & holds reviews before the test. Go to class, listen & write down the examples, and pre-write the answers to the possible short answer q's & memorize them
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Shes as nice of a professor as you can have and has clear grading criteria and tells you exactly what to study. Plenty of reading, just like any sociology class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Dietrich is a beautiful and wonderful person, but A TOUGH PROFESSOR. Four tests that are extremely detailed, and if you bomb one, it is extremely hard to improve to an A. A B is easy to do and she's a great lecturer, but if you are looking for a shoe-in to an A, this isn't the right choice.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I would not recommend her. Only 4 grades all weighed evenly. The tests are VERY detailed and most the notes in class don't even go into the test. Basically if you make one B you are stuck with a B. The lectures are so detailed it is excruciating. There are much easier SOCI credits.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: 3 exams with a study guide provided, 1 term paper that is long but not graded hard. She's super sweet and funny, PowerPoints are straightforward, have to skim a few readings to fill out study guide. Not hard if you put forth a little effort. Held a high A all semester. Definitely recommend and would take again
reviews.ratingTags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: wonderful lady! lots of information in the class. if you don't go to class you're missing on lots of notes. also the test are hard but if you do the review she gives you, you will do fine. the paper is a drag but overall good class.

I've taken Dietrich for 430, Social Problems, and internship. She's an extremely smart and nice lady, but at the end of the day she is a tough professor. In 430 the exams are very difficult with approx. 15 multiple choice, 7 matching, and 6 essays. Know your stuff verbatim or get loads of points off. Final grade determined by tests + weekly papers.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: There is a 15 page paper in her Social Problems class, but her lectures are great and very interactive. Do your readings and attend class or you won't pass though
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Dietrich is adorable and friendly. Go to the test reviews and you will do well

Out of all the papers she assigns to you they are very helpful to write about when it comes time for her exams. The exams are both written and multiple choice but she helps you with the study guide and is very specific about what she wants, which is good to me. She loves talking about her own experiences.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Professor Dietrich is actually the head of the Sociology Department, so she is very knowledgeable and well-respected. I found her tests to be ultra-specific and it seemed very hard to please her. Her lectures were not heavily tested over, which is good because she was extremely boring.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I absolutely love dr. Dietrich. I've taken every class she teaches (SOCI 324, SOCI 430, SOCI478) , including doing the internship program (SOCI 484). She is the best and really cares about her students. Plus she's cute and goofy !

1 paper and 3 tests (25% each). Dr. D is a cute old lady, but lecture is pretty boring. she posts a review for each test and all readings on e-campus. All tests are multiple choice, with one essay, so if you're good at memorizing statistics and common sense regarding social problems (poverty, immigration, etc), you'll do fine
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She is a teacher that reminds you a lot of your grandma. She loves to engage her students, and challenge them. Time-consuming with LOTS OF READING! Test are challenging, but if you study in depth you should be okay, & gives you brief reviews/loves to answer questions in office hours! Paper is 15 pages but lets you pick own topic! Take her!!
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--TEST HEAVY--Caring

reviews.comment: I took her Social Problems class and I really enjoyed it! There are only 4 grades in the course (3 tests and 1 term paper), and as long as you go to class and put in some effort you will be okay! Her tests are hard if you don't study, but she gives study guides so do them and you'll be fine!!!
